'''Oleg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. By the time Empress [[Vaylin]] took the [[Eternal Throne]], Oleg was a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] working at the Royal [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]]. During the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]] he scolded apprentive [[Bev]] for letting [[Bergola]] get sick, while also preparing his beasts to be unleashed on captured Zakuulan rebels at Vaylin's command. After Vaylin's speech was interrupted by the arrival of first [[Alliance Commander]] and then former Emperor [[Arcann]], Oleg sent a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] named [[Junior (rancor)|Junior]] as well as a pack of [[Exoboar]]s including [[Brick (exoboar)|Brick]], [[Lil' Jwizzix]] and [[Rompy]] to deal with the rebels. He then went to battle Arcann's loyalists himself, accompanied by two [[vorn tiger]]s [[Cho'Kri]] and [[Cho'Ale]]. They were all killed during the three-way fighting in the Palace reception area.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beast Master Oleg appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during "Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw."
